subject.title: feat(ledger): add immutable action history core

question: Do maintainers accept the documented v1 trusted-root model and broad immutable ledger contract as ClawSweeper's durable action-history foundation?
rationale: The implementation is internally consistent and well tested, but permanent compatibility obligations and reliance on workspace ownership and process isolation require explicit repository-level intent.

options.title: Accept and integrate
options.body: Approve the v1 contract and require exact-head end-to-end proof from the dependent instrumentation PR before authoritative rollout.

options.title: Strengthen isolation first
options.body: Delay adoption until deployment or platform mechanisms enforce a stricter filesystem boundary.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Reduce the initial schema or runtime surface before downstream workflows depend on it.

recommendation.title: Accept and integrate
recommendation.body: Approve the v1 contract and require exact-head end-to-end proof from the dependent instrumentation PR before authoritative rollout.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent designed and documented the architecture and security boundary; independent review from the workflow owner remains appropriate.
